# Explore SQLite Database
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(RSQLite)
library(DBI)
```
```{r connectDatabase}
# Connect to SQLite database
sqliteConn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "data/subscribersDB.sqlitedb")
```
```{r listTables}
# Step 1: List all tables
tables <- dbListTables(sqliteConn)
print("Tables in SQLite database:")
print(tables)
```
```{r exploreAllTables}
# Step 2: For each table, get structure and sample data
for(table in tables) {
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("TABLE:", table, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  
  # Get column info
  cols <- dbGetQuery(sqliteConn, paste0("PRAGMA table_info(", table, ")"))
  print(cols)
  
  # Get sample rows
  cat("\nSample data:\n")
  sample <- dbGetQuery(sqliteConn, paste0("SELECT * FROM ", table, " LIMIT 5"))
  print(sample)
  
  # Get row count
  count <- dbGetQuery(sqliteConn, paste0("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM ", table))
  cat("\nTotal rows:", count$count, "\n")
}
```
```{r disconnect}
# Don't forget to disconnect
dbDisconnect(sqliteConn)
```

```{r reconnect}
# Reconnect for detailed exploration
sqliteConn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "data/subscribersDB.sqlitedb")
```
```{r exploreSubscribers}
cat("========== SUBSCRIBERS TABLE ==========\n")
dbGetQuery(sqliteConn, "PRAGMA table_info(subscribers)")
dbGetQuery(sqliteConn, "SELECT * FROM subscribers LIMIT 3")
```

```{r exploreCSV}
cat("========== CSV FILE ==========\n")
csv_file <- "data/new-streaming-transactions-98732.csv"

if(file.exists(csv_file)) {
  # Read first few rows
  df_csv <- read.csv(csv_file, nrows = 10)
  
  cat("\nColumn names and types:\n")
  str(df_csv)
  
  cat("\nFirst 5 rows:\n")
  print(head(df_csv, 5))
  
  # Count total rows
  total_rows <- length(readLines(csv_file)) - 1
  cat("\nTotal rows in CSV:", total_rows, "\n")
  
} else {
  cat("ERROR: CSV file not found!\n")
  cat("Make sure you extracted the ZIP file to the data/ folder\n")
}
```

